email.subject: Polar Works: a couple quick fixes for Harbor Falls searches
email.body:
Hi Jack,

I looked at Polar Works' site. Two things are likely costing you booked jobs: there's no way to request an appointment online, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next HVAC company, and your hours aren't listed anywhere, which makes people unsure if you're open before they even call.

I also noticed no customer reviews are shown and the footer looks out of date, which can make visitors second-guess you.

I fix stuff like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
